title: Anti-Idiocracy
spine: The book moves from socially rewarded error to its specific Outfinitist community proposal; a hypothetical AI recruitment review shows how different limits change authority, then the same discipline is applied to founding texts, useful support and successful leaders.

source.scope: Full chapter map; complete source-3,4,5,6,7,15,40,41,59,60,61,62,65,66,67,69,70,71,72,73,74,76,78. Not the entire book or an external reference audit. Previously truncated broad read was replaced by complete bounded reads of every listed late section.

scenes.title: Who gets heard
lines: Anti-Idiocracy asks why accurate arguments lose to cultures that reward confident error.
Its opening evolutionary debate shows a quick joke defeating a careful explanation.
The book argues that correction needs belonging, practical support, and limits on authority.
It develops Outfinitism, a proposed discipline for studying where our models stop working.
Its Outfinitist metacult would turn that discipline into shared practices and mutual support.
Members must remain free to challenge leaders without losing their place.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Recognition of an unfair conversational shortcut, frustration at blocked explanation, then curiosity about a social alternative.
scenes.artPlan: Enact the source opening on a small discussion stage: one adult interrupts with a confident gesture while a second tries to explain a branching ancestry drawing. A small audience initially turns toward the interrupter, leaving the actual two-branch drawing ignored. No monkey-to-human ladder: both present-day cousins terminate distinct branches from a shared ancestor. As the narration turns to correction, attention returns to the actual drawing and the explainer. The spotlight then widens into an equal-height circle, including the former interrupter rather than expelling them. A visible time-limited facilitator token passes away from the initial confident speaker. This is the source’s conceptual debate, not a claim about a real named event. No giant slogans or four concept cards.

scenes.title: A decision with consequences
lines: The book makes this concrete through a hypothetical gathering around automated recruitment.
A founder brings an AI system designed to select job candidates.
A specialist asks which population was used to validate its predictions.
An applicant asks who can appeal when those predictions reject someone.
The group also asks whether applicants retain a route without automated selection.
Each perspective exposes a different limit, turning model evaluation into questions of authority.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Focused investigation: initially narrow confidence opens into concern for the person affected, then agency through visible unanswered questions.
scenes.artPlan: A developed recruitment demonstration around a large freestanding terminal: founder operates candidate-selection software; the adult applicant carries an actual application folio. A machine-learning specialist pulls the validation drawer into view, labelled Validation population?, with no fabricated population or measured accuracy. On the appeal sentence, the applicant follows the rejected application out of the terminal and points to the missing review destination; a question-mark review tray appears as a question, not a successfully deployed remedy. On the alternative-route sentence, the composition widens to a human application desk beside the machine, initially marked Available? The camera/staging moves from device internals to applicant experience to the two routes. All participants remain visible as people with distinct expertise, not disconnected icons. The source explicitly makes this meeting hypothetical; no unsupported rejection cause, demographic claim, metrics or implemented guarantee.

scenes.title: Correction without exile
lines: The chapters then ask how such a community could correct itself.
Founding texts must remain open to challenge, with changes recorded across editions.
Members can carry evidence of their contributions when leaving, while protecting private data.
Useful support might mean finding an independent evaluator or closing a project without stigma.
The proposed culture earns belonging through practical help, rather than demands for allegiance.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Tension at disagreeing with an originator, release when the disagreement preserves relationships and useful work.
scenes.artPlan: Shift to a shared print-and-repair room, not another screen discussion. A contributor annotates an actual bound founding text beside its originator; a replacement edition is set next to the preserved previous edition rather than erasing it. Widen to an adult preparing to leave: their contribution folio carries identifiable authored work and its verifier while a separate confidential envelope remains in the room. The people exchange a professional recommendation even as a closed-project model is packed away. A waiting colleague offers an evaluator contact, making support useful after disappointment. No magical continuity of every asset or private disclosure: only evidence and materials the person has rights to take. Proposed institutional practices are a conceptual demonstration, not a report of an operating organization.

scenes.title: When the group succeeds
lines: Success creates another test, because money and reputation can make leaders harder to challenge.
The book proposes limited mandates, independent scrutiny, and conditions for ending failed institutions.
Equal dignity stays unconditional, while decision-making authority must remain limited and revocable.
Begin with A Day in an Outfinitist Circle, then examine Protections Against Success.
Read the wider argument to judge whether this community could practice its own principles.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Success introduces a new risk, then a grounded reading invitation rather than recruitment or a guaranteed solution.
scenes.artPlan: A local circle has grown into a busy assembly. The original facilitator is raised on a growing platform as prestige accumulates; an ordinary contributor’s question can no longer reach them. An expiring mandate is visible on the actual facilitator’s lectern. Independent participants lower the platform and open the floor to the affected member; a second person takes the facilitation token while the former leader remains an ordinary participant. This visualizes the proposed bounded authority without suggesting social worth depends on rank. A clearly marked Closed institutional sign is available as a limit, not an invented story of this movement actually closing. Finish by opening a proportionate real volume at the two named source sections, with generous type, no repeated reading commands or recruitment button.

evidence.heading: Why Being Right Is Not Enough
evidence.quote: A ten-second error can defeat a ten-minute truth in a social environment that grants status to the person who appears to have won, not to the person who has understood more.

evidence.heading: Why Being Right Is Not Enough
evidence.quote: It claims that different branches share ancestors.

evidence.heading: The basic concepts
evidence.quote: Outfinitism is the term proposed here. It sharpens the meta-rational impulse by organizing it around the systematic study of limits: the limits of theories, models, measurements, institutions, technologies, categories, and our own capacities.

evidence.heading: A metacult, and this metacult
evidence.quote: A conventional cult protects its center from doubt. A metacult makes the capacity to doubt its own center part of what it protects.

evidence.heading: The Outfinitist Metacult: Belonging Built on Fallibility
evidence.quote: A metacult is a voluntary, decentralized, and self-correcting culture that turns broad, revisable commitments into repeated practices, mutual support, institutional memory, and collective action.

evidence.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
evidence.quote: A founder presents an AI system for selecting job candidates. Instead of asking only whether the model is accurate, the group maps its limits. On which population was it validated? Which errors are most costly? Who can appeal? Which data are absent? Is a non-automated route available?

evidence.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
evidence.quote: A machine-learning specialist sees technical limits. A lawyer sees rights. A person recently subjected to automated recruitment sees the human experience. An entrepreneur sees cost and market constraints. A psychologist sees how applicants may change behavior under evaluation. No perspective is sufficient alone.

evidence.heading: The founder who refuses the role of prophet
evidence.quote: Founding texts should be open to annotation, contestable, and replaceable by later editions.

evidence.heading: The founder who refuses the role of prophet
evidence.quote: Members should be able to demonstrate that the founder is wrong without being treated as enemies of the project.

evidence.heading: Local power, global memory, and the right to fork
evidence.quote: The network should preserve versions of rules, decisions, arguments, experiments, and outcomes.

evidence.heading: Local power, global memory, and the right to fork
evidence.quote: Members should be able to export evidence of work, recommendations, and materials to which they have rights. Intimate data must not travel automatically.

evidence.heading: A community worth existing
evidence.quote: a founder closes a nonviable project without losing every professional relationship;

evidence.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
evidence.quote: Someone needs an independent evaluator. Someone has closed a company and needs a professional recommendation that does not translate closure into stigma.

evidence.heading: Protections against success
evidence.quote: A small project may appear virtuous because nothing valuable can yet be captured. The real test begins when money, reputation, access, and political relevance arrive.

evidence.heading: Protections against success
evidence.quote: The defense is publication of power relations, access to minutes, limited mandates, independent audits, and, in some contexts, randomly selected members alongside relevant expertise.

evidence.heading: Protections against success
evidence.quote: If such practices become systemic and cannot be corrected, the organization should close, rename, or be forked openly.

evidence.heading: The direction of the Outfinitist metacult
evidence.quote: It insists on equal dignity and on matching authority to demonstrated competence, limited scope, visible responsibility, and revocability.

evidence.heading: An invitation, not an oath
evidence.quote: She returns when that value proves repeatable. She contributes if others benefit.
